title: Stable-ASR Adapter Registry
description: Adapter and baseline registry for reproducible turn-taking, streaming ASR, transcript conversion, and command-backed external system evaluation.

adapters.title: Rule Endpoint Baseline
adapters.input_schema: TurnManifestRecord
adapters.notes: Lowest endpointing baseline using manifest metadata.

adapters.title: VAD Pause Baseline
adapters.input_schema: TurnManifestRecord
adapters.notes: Industrial-style pause threshold baseline.

adapters.title: Text Turn Baseline
adapters.input_schema: TurnManifestRecord
adapters.notes: Simple semantic baseline over reference or ASR text.

adapters.title: External Turn Prediction Manifest
adapters.input_schema: Stable-ASR turn prediction JSONL
adapters.notes: Dependency-light bridge for SmartTurn/EasyTurn/VAP-style outputs.

adapters.title: Transcript JSONL Streaming ASR Adapter
adapters.input_schema: Stable-ASR StreamingASRRecord JSONL
adapters.notes: Adapter used by eval-streaming-asr, compare-streaming-asr, and sweep-streaming-asr.

adapters.title: Command-Backed Streaming ASR Adapter
adapters.input_schema: command writes Stable-ASR StreamingASRRecord JSONL
adapters.notes: Runs an external command and evaluates the transcript JSONL it writes.

adapters.title: Whisper Transcript Converter
adapters.input_schema: Whisper-style segments/words JSONL
adapters.notes: Normalizes Whisper segment and word timestamp exports.

adapters.title: FunASR Transcript Converter
adapters.input_schema: FunASR-style sentence_info/timestamp JSONL
adapters.notes: Normalizes FunASR sentence and timestamp exports.

adapters.title: Whisper Command Template
adapters.input_schema: local audio or manifest handled by external script
adapters.notes: Template for wrapping Whisper or faster-whisper exporters without adding a hard dependency.

adapters.title: FunASR Command Template
adapters.input_schema: local audio or manifest handled by external script
adapters.notes: Template for evaluating FunASR-style systems through the command adapter.

adapters.title: FireRedASR2S Command Template
adapters.input_schema: FireRedASR2S JSONL or normalized transcript export
adapters.notes: Template for evaluating FireRedASR2S ASR, VAD, LID, punctuation, word timestamp, and code-switching outputs through Stable-ASR metrics.

adapters.title: Qwen3-ASR Command Template
adapters.input_schema: Qwen3-ASR transcript, timestamp, streaming, or forced-alignment export
adapters.notes: Template for evaluating Qwen3-ASR multilingual, streaming, timestamp, and forced-alignment behavior without vendoring the model stack.

adapters.title: SenseVoice Command Template
adapters.input_schema: SenseVoice rich transcription export
adapters.notes: Template for evaluating SenseVoice ASR plus rich speech-understanding outputs such as LID, emotion, and audio events.

adapters.title: WeNet Command Template
adapters.input_schema: local audio or manifest handled by external script
adapters.notes: Template for evaluating WeNet systems without vendoring WeNet.

adapters.title: sherpa-onnx Command Template
adapters.input_schema: local audio or manifest handled by external script
adapters.notes: Template for evaluating sherpa-onnx runtime exports, including CPU and embedded deployment reports.

adapters.title: whisper.cpp Command Template
adapters.input_schema: whisper.cpp transcript, segment, or word timestamp export
adapters.notes: Template for evaluating C/C++ Whisper runtimes, quantized models, CPU latency, and edge deployment reports.

adapters.title: Lhotse Manifest Bridge Template
adapters.entrypoint: planned: lhotse cuts/supervisions to Stable-ASR ASR/turn manifests
adapters.input_schema: Lhotse recording/cut/supervision manifests
adapters.notes: Planning template for interoperating with Lhotse instead of duplicating mature corpus recipes.

adapters.title: Kaldi Recipe Bridge Template
adapters.entrypoint: planned: Kaldi data dirs, wav.scp, segments, and text to Stable-ASR ASR manifests
adapters.input_schema: Kaldi-style data directory metadata
adapters.notes: Template for learning from Kaldi recipe structure and converting mature corpus metadata without vendoring Kaldi.

adapters.title: ESPnet Command Template
adapters.input_schema: ESPnet recipe output or external transcript export
adapters.notes: Template for comparing ESPnet recipe outputs with Stable-ASR latency, timestamp, and streaming metrics.

adapters.title: NeMo Speech Command Template
adapters.input_schema: NeMo ASR transcript or timestamp export
adapters.notes: Template for evaluating NeMo ASR checkpoints and deployment reports without adding a hard NeMo dependency.

adapters.title: SpeechBrain Command Template
adapters.input_schema: SpeechBrain recipe output or pretrained ASR transcript export
adapters.notes: Template for using SpeechBrain recipes and pretrained baselines as external systems in Stable-ASR reports.

adapters.title: icefall Command Template
adapters.input_schema: icefall/k2 ASR recipe output
adapters.notes: Template for evaluating k2/icefall CTC and transducer recipes through the shared Stable-ASR command adapter.

adapters.title: faster-whisper Command Template
adapters.input_schema: faster-whisper transcript segments
adapters.notes: Template for benchmarking quantized and batched Whisper inference variants with RTF and latency metrics.

adapters.title: WhisperX Transcript Template
adapters.entrypoint: planned: whisperx segments, word timestamps, and diarization metadata to Stable-ASR StreamingASRRecord JSONL
adapters.input_schema: WhisperX segment, word alignment, and diarization output
adapters.notes: Template for timestamp-stability and diarization-aware streaming transcript evaluation.

adapters.title: Moonshine Command Template
adapters.input_schema: Moonshine transcript event or final transcript export
adapters.notes: Template for evaluating low-latency on-device ASR, live transcript events, and edge runtime tradeoffs.

adapters.title: WhisperKit Command Template
adapters.input_schema: WhisperKit or Argmax SDK transcript export
adapters.notes: Template for tracking Apple on-device ASR latency, Core ML model metadata, and mobile deployment constraints.

adapters.title: Hugging Face Transformers ASR Template
adapters.input_schema: Transformers ASR pipeline or model hub transcript export
adapters.notes: Template for evaluating Hugging Face ASR pipelines, hub checkpoints, and fine-tuned models under Stable-ASR metrics.

adapters.title: SmartTurn Prediction Converter
adapters.input_schema: SmartTurn-style completion probability JSONL
adapters.notes: Converts SmartTurn-like probabilities into the shared prediction adapter format.

adapters.title: EasyTurn Prediction Converter
adapters.input_schema: EasyTurn-style four-state prediction JSONL
adapters.notes: Converts EasyTurn-like predictions into the shared prediction adapter format.

adapters.title: VAP Prediction Template
adapters.input_schema: generic prediction JSONL with probs and timestamp
adapters.notes: Template for mapping VAP-style future activity scores to Stable-ASR turn probabilities.

adapters.title: Pipecat Voice-Agent Bridge Template
adapters.entrypoint: planned: export Pipecat VAD, turn-detector, ASR, TTS, and interruption events to Stable-ASR traces
adapters.input_schema: Pipecat frame, transport, and processor event logs
adapters.output_schema: Stable-ASR turn manifests, streaming ASR traces, or VoiceWorld event traces
adapters.notes: Template for documenting runtime boundaries between Stable-ASR evaluation and a production voice-agent framework without replacing Pipecat.

adapters.title: Silero VAD Endpointing Template
adapters.entrypoint: planned: Silero VAD speech segments to Stable-ASR pause metadata and turn probabilities
adapters.input_schema: audio window or Silero VAD speech timestamps
adapters.notes: Template for benchmarking neural VAD pause endpointing against rule and metadata-only baselines.

adapters.title: WebRTC VAD Endpointing Template
adapters.entrypoint: planned: WebRTC VAD frames to Stable-ASR pause metadata and turn probabilities
adapters.input_schema: audio frames or WebRTC VAD speech/non-speech decisions
adapters.notes: Template for comparing a traditional low-dependency VAD endpointing path with neural VAD and turn-action models.
